[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Fast (6, Hard Mode) |hidden = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Sugrawr''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Eggy Island]] as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. It appeared in easy mode with 30 health and in hard mode with 50 health. It had slightly above average speed in easy mode but was much faster in hard mode. ==Appearance== The '''Sugrawr''' had cyan blue skin, and its torso and legs were yellow. It wore a cut in half candy wrapper and had a smile face. It had an unusual running animation, flailing its arms as it ran. ==Strategy== *In easy mode, several [[Soldier]]s is enough defeat the '''Sugrawr'''. **You can also save up for the [[Minigunner]], so long someone else places down other towers to defend from the [[Zombegg]]s that debut before the '''Sugrawr'''. *The [[Pyromancer]] can slow down hordes of '''Sugrawrs'''. Additionally, in hard mode, the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Frost Blaster]] can also be used to slow down the '''Sugrawr'''. **The [[Freezer]] can also be used, though be aware of its slow projectile speed. *In hard mode, the [[Archer|Holiday Archer]] can be used as an effective tower against the '''Sugrawr'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NoobFace.png|'''Sugrawr's''' face. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Sugrawr''' was a portmanteau of the words "sugar" and "rawr", with the latter being an onomatopoeia of "roar". ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Sugrawr''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Sugrawr''' removed. {{EggyIsland|[[Zombegg]]
